rules.sentence: Except for the Bicuspid aortic valve, many patients with congenital heart defects, if they remain untreated, die in infancy or early childhood.[61]
At some point in life, these patients may require either palliative or corrective surgeries or noncardiac surgeries during adulthood.
Sometimes, the Fontan procedure is the only option in case of a hypoplastic right ventricle.[60]
